capabilities: Export single notes to PDF or HTML from the context menu or editor
Batch-export folders or multiple selected notes as PDF or HTML
Package batch exports as a ZIP archive or share files via the native mobile share sheet
Customize PDF page size, orientation, margins, text size, and optional title
Disable desktop support when the plugin is only wanted on mobile
extras: PDF export downloads a WASM component (Takumi PDF 0.15.0) from jsDelivr on first use, then works offline; exports are prepared locally and very large batches may exceed device memory. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to export notes to shareable PDF or HTML files from mobile devices.

relations.evidence: The component in question is Takumi PDF for browser use (WASM)

summary: Export plugin that converts notes to PDF or HTML from mobile or desktop, with single-note, multi-select, and folder batch export.
